 "command": "mkdir -p programs && cat > programs/task-5c2fa84a.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    # Four 4x4 monochrome masks are separated by the 3-valued divider.
    colors = (8, 5, 9, 4)
    priority = (8, 5, 4, 9)
    out = []
    for r in range(4):
        row = []
        for c in range(4):
            present = [color for color, start in zip(colors, (0, 5, 10, 15)) if grid[r][start+c] == color]
            chosen = next((color for color in priority if color in present), 0)
            row.append(chosen)
        out.append(row)
    return out
PY
